name: Concórdia (Brazil)
description: Vertical tricolour of red, green and red, charged at the centre with a large white lozenge bearing the municipal arms with a scroll reading CONCÓRDIA.
history: Concórdia is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag and arms were prescribed by Municipal Law No. 955 of 18 November 1968; the dove on the arms stands for peace, harmony and concord, the municipality's namesake.

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown, a shield divided red and green with a dove, wheat and a scroll reading CONCÓRDIA
